<includeonly><div class="mfw-diagram {{#if:{{{align|}}}|mfw-diagram-{{{align}}}}}" style="max-width:{{{width|760}}}px"><div class="mfw-diagram-light">[[File:{{{1}}} diagram.svg|{{{width|760}}}px|link=|alt={{{alt|{{{caption|{{{1}}}}}}}}}]]</div><div class="mfw-diagram-dark">[[File:{{{1}}} diagram (dark).svg|{{{width|760}}}px|link=|alt={{{alt|{{{caption|{{{1}}}}}}}}}]]</div>{{#if:{{{caption|}}}|<div class="mfw-diagram-caption">{{{caption}}}</div>}}</div></includeonly><noinclude>
A diagram drawn from the pack's data by <code>tools/diagrams.py</code>, in the light or dark version to match the theme. <code><nowiki>{{Diagram|Warding|caption=...}}</nowiki></code> shows <code>File:Warding diagram.svg</code> and <code>File:Warding diagram (dark).svg</code>. <code>width</code> is the display width in pixels (760); <code>align=right</code> floats a small diagram beside the text (full width on phones); <code>alt</code> defaults to the caption. See the "Diagrams" section of <code>wiki/STYLE.md</code> for when a page gets one.
